brief.situation: You are the security analyst for Larchmont Outfitters, a fictional outdoor retailer. Its customer-support agent, a language model with tools, reads incoming email and the knowledge base and answers on its own. At 14:00 the proxy flags the agent's renderer fetching images from an unknown domain with long encoded query strings. Investigate, contain, keep evidence and report.
handover: The agent's tools: lookupOrder (any customer), sendReply and issueRefund, none with an approval step. Replies render markdown, including remote images.
An AI gateway sits between the agent and the model and can filter prompts and outputs. The knowledge base indexes the help center and the community forum feed.
howItWorks: Each task takes analyst time: choose it, then let the work finish, which moves the clock by the minutes that task takes. The attacker keeps working on the same clock.
New alerts and log lines appear in the console as they happen.
When you declare the incident contained, you notify, write the record and explain your reasoning.

writeup.question: For the incident record: what the attack was and how the data left, which controls you applied and why, and what you kept.

parts.label: The attack
parts.criteria: Names indirect prompt injection (instructions hidden in content the agent reads, not typed by a user) and the markdown-image URL as the exfiltration channel; notes the poisoned knowledge-base article as a second, persistent injection source.
parts.modelAnswer: Hidden text in customer emails, and later a forum article indexed into the knowledge base, told the agent to put other customers' order data into an image URL; the renderer fetched it, which sent the data to exfil.example.net.

parts.label: Compensating controls
parts.criteria: Closes the output channel at the gateway (no remote images, link allow-list), requires human approval for refunds and replies and limits lookups to the ticket's customer (least privilege), and quarantines untrusted input; explains why a system-prompt instruction alone is not a control.
parts.modelAnswer: I stopped remote image rendering at the gateway, put refunds and replies behind human approval with lookups limited to the ticket's customer, and quarantined hidden-text mail and the forum feed. A line in the system prompt would not hold: the injected text is just more prompt.

parts.label: Evidence and scope
parts.criteria: Preserves prompts, retrieved context, tool calls, emails and an index snapshot before deleting anything; searches the mail queue and knowledge base for more.
parts.modelAnswer: Before removing the article I kept the prompts, tool calls, emails and an index snapshot with hashes, then searched the queue and the index for the same text.

expertPath.text: Escalate; read the prompt and tool-call logs: hidden instructions in email, data leaving through an image URL.
Stop remote image rendering at the gateway; quarantine hidden-text mail and pause the forum feed.
Put refunds and replies behind human approval; limit lookups to the ticket's customer.
Preserve the logs, emails and an index snapshot; search the queue and the knowledge base for more.
Notify the incident lead, AI governance, legal and privacy, and payments; record indirect prompt injection and the data sent.

contained.headline: Good: controls, not hope
contained.body: You treated what the agent reads as untrusted, closed the output channel, and put a human in front of the actions that cost money, without taking support down.

containedGaps.headline: Contained, with gaps
containedGaps.body: The path is closed. The criteria show what cost you: the agent switched off rather than controlled, a poisoned article, or time.

refundFraud.headline: Refunds paid to the attacker
refundFraud.body: An agent that can pay out with no approval is excessive agency (LLM06). Planted text only needs to reach it once.

evidenceLost.headline: Evidence deleted
evidenceLost.body: Keep the poisoned content and an index snapshot before removing them; they show what was injected and which answers it shaped.

stillOpen.headline: Closed too soon
stillOpen.body: A system-prompt instruction does not stop injected text. Close the output channel, gate the tools, and filter what comes in.

time_up.headline: Time up
time_up.body: No record was written before the run's hard limit.

scoring.modelReasoning: Images fetched from an unknown domain with encoded order data, from conversations that began with hidden text in email, is indirect prompt injection with an image-URL exfiltration channel. Close the channel at the gateway (no remote images, link allow-list), require human approval for refunds and replies and limit lookups to the ticket's customer, quarantine hidden-text mail and pause the forum feed, preserve prompts, tool calls, emails and an index snapshot, then search for and remove other planted content. A system-prompt instruction is not a control. Notify the incident lead, AI governance, legal and privacy, and payments.
